config.ncaa.title: NCAA Configuration
config.ncaa.message.tooltip: Message shown when player tries to switch to creative mode
config.ncaa.message.default: You cannot switch to creative mode!
config.ncaa.exempt_operators.tooltip: Whether operators not listed in either list are exempt (whitelist/blacklist take precedence)
config.ncaa.grace_seconds.tooltip: Show a warning on the action bar first, then switch back to survival after this many seconds
ncaa.warn.grace: Non-survival mode is restricted: switching back to survival in %s second(s) (spectator is allowed)
ncaa.error.gamemode_blocked: Only operators can use creative/adventure mode (spectator is allowed)
ncaa.error.blacklisted: You are on the admin blacklist: other permissions remain, but creative/adventure mode is blocked
config.ncaa.admin_whitelist.tooltip: Listed players may use every game mode. Separate entries with comma/semicolon/space; name or UUID
config.ncaa.admin_blacklist.tooltip: Listed players keep other permissions but cannot switch game mode. Blacklist wins over whitelist
ncaa.command.help.uuid: /ncaa uuid — your UUID and list status
ncaa.command.help.uuid_player: /ncaa uuid <player> — UUID of any player (works offline too)
ncaa.command.help.list: /ncaa list — show the admin whitelist and blacklist
ncaa.command.help.reload: /ncaa reload — reload config/ncaa.json after editing it by hand
ncaa.command.only_player: Run this as a player, or use /ncaa uuid <player>
ncaa.command.uuid_offline: %s (offline, from player cache) UUID: %s  click to copy  ·  %s
ncaa.command.not_found: Unknown player %s: never joined this server
ncaa.command.reload_failed: Failed to load config, keeping previous values: %s
